readerCopy.body: A clear rule, deadline, or commitment can make an unfamiliar direction easier to build around. When Saturn sextiles the North Node, structure and forward movement cooperate, allowing a formal offer, reliable schedule, defined responsibility, or practical condition to give a newer plan enough support to become workable. A limit can protect the time, money, authority, or resources the change needs instead of merely restricting it.
